column2: The Magic Menace

A startling turn of events. Our [From.GetTitle] has determined that [From.GetReasonToRelaxMagicLaws]
The new law decrees [From.GetNewMagicRights]

The witch hunters are already muttering in the taverns, and the priests in their pulpits.

Our [From.GetTitle] has determined that [From.GetReasonToExpandMagicLaws]
The new law decrees [From.GetNewMagicRights]

The hedge wizards are packing their bags, and the witch hunters are sharpening their stakes.
This was a necessary step.
A good choice.
The end times are near!

[scoped_magic_ruler.GetTitledFirstName] has clearly lost [scoped_magic_ruler.GetHerHis] mind. Yet with the authority [scoped_magic_ruler.GetSheHe] has gathered, [scoped_magic_ruler.GetSheHe] might yet turn our realm into a nest of sorcerers and a door for the Dark Gods. [scoped_magic_ruler.GetSheHeCap] must be stopped now, before it is too late!

[scoped_magic_ruler.GetTitledFirstName] has clearly lost [scoped_magic_ruler.GetHerHis] mind, persecuting magic in our realm once more. With the authority [scoped_magic_ruler.GetSheHe] has gathered, [scoped_magic_ruler.GetSheHe] might turn our realm into a land of superstitious fools and burning pyres. [scoped_magic_ruler.GetSheHeCap] must be stopped now, before it is too late!
We must rise up and depose this tyrant!
Send letters urging every lord of the realm to band together against the madman on the throne.
There is nothing we can do.

To all the faithful!\nMadness has taken our [scoped_magic_ruler.GetTitle]. Sorcerers walk free at court, and the Dark Gods are laughing. We must stand together and depose the fool on the throne, or watch Chaos spread across our land.\n[From.GetTitledName]

To my fellow lords! Do not believe the lies of the superstitious!\nMadness has taken our [scoped_magic_ruler.GetTitle]. We must stand together and depose the fool on the throne, or see our families and our people burned at the stake on the whims of witch hunters!\n[From.GetTitledName]
Death to the tyrant!
These are the words of a traitor.
The time has come!\nAll of us who suffer under the yoke of our mad [scoped_magic_ruler.GetTitle] have gathered under my banner, and we are ready to bring the tyrant to justice.
To war!

Several indignant vassals have banded together against the new magic law. They have taken up arms to overthrow their own [scoped_magic_ruler.GetTitle] and restore what they call the rightful way of things.
Traitors, all of them!
I cannot say I am surprised...
A New Day

Despite the fury over [FromFrom.GetHerHis] decision that [FromFrom.GetReasonToRelaxMagicLaws] [FromFrom.GetTitledFirstName] has won the realm's civil war, and the new magic law stands. After such a show of strength, the [FromFrom.GetTitle] has found new supporters among both the people and the nobility.

Despite the fury over [FromFrom.GetHerHis] decision that [FromFrom.GetReasonToExpandMagicLaws] [FromFrom.GetTitledFirstName] has won the realm's civil war, and the new magic law stands. After such a show of strength, the [FromFrom.GetTitle] has found new supporters among both the people and the nobility.
We have been vindicated!
So be it.
This is horrible!

For all the outrage over [From.GetTitledFirstName]'s decision that [From.GetReasonToRelaxMagicLaws] not one of [From.GetHerHis] vassals was willing to contest it by force of arms. The new magic law stands.

For all the outrage over [From.GetTitledFirstName]'s decision that [From.GetReasonToExpandMagicLaws] not one of [From.GetHerHis] vassals was willing to contest it by force of arms. The new magic law stands.

I am afraid the faction I speak for must insist on a change to the realm's magic laws. We are fully prepared to take up arms should you refuse, and rest assured, we have the men to enforce our just demand...

Signed,
[From.GetTitledName]
Very well. The law will change.
Never! Come and take it, then.

Rather than let civil war tear the realm apart, [From.GetTitledName] has agreed to change the magic law. Your support will not be forgotten.

Sincerely,
[FromFrom.GetTitledName]
Good.
Under pressure from a powerful faction, [From.GetTitledName] has agreed to change the realm's magic law.
I see.

Your disloyalty is shocking. Still, to spare the realm a civil war, I will make the change you demand.

Signed,
[From.GetTitledName]
Excellent.
It has been decades since magic was made lawful. A few fervent detractors still rage, but the common folk and the nobility alike are coming to accept what magic can do for them.
We have been vindicated!
This is horrible!
§YHumans are more inclined to support magic§!\n
A Magical Realm

Interesting news of an uprising. A peasant rebellion would normally be beneath our notice, but its leader, [From.GetTitledFirstName], is a mage, and has declared [From.GetHerHis] new realm a haven for magic users the world over.
Interesting.
This is horrible!
Your court mage, [From.GetFirstName], can no longer carry out [From.GetHerHis] duties.
I see.
